name: local-archive-firefox
description: Local Telegram conversation exporter for Firefox.
author: Stranmor

scripts.dev:install: npm run build && npm run dev:loader && "$HOME/.local/bin/local-archive-firefox-dev-loader" --socket "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/local-archive-firefox-dev/devtools.sock" --addon .output/firefox-mv3 --addon-id '{893462e9-4b44-4be5-97d6-f7178ef693b6}' --version 3.0.0 --receipt "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/local-archive-firefox-dev/install-receipt.json"
scripts.build: npm run rust:build && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:chromium: npm run rust:build && wxt build -b chrome --mv3
scripts.zip: npm run rust:build && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
scripts.check: npm run rust:fmt:check && npm run rust:lint && npm run rust:test && npm run rust:build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:extension && npm run verify:build && npm run verify:release && npm run lint:addon
scripts.check:consumer: npm run zip && npm run verify:build && npm run test:e2e:firefox
scripts.check:live-smoke: npm run zip && npm run test:smoke:telegram-web
scripts.package:release: npm run check && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && node scripts/package-sources.mjs && npm run prepare:amo && node scripts/verify-release-artifacts.mjs
